title: Turbo-RIP: A Protocol for TurboID-based RNA Immunopurification in Plants
author: Zhi Zhang
license_note: PMC full-text XML — Bio-protocol — CC-BY confirmed in article XML

steps.title: Prepare plant material
steps.instruction: Sterilize 10 × 10 cm mesh squares by autoclaving, cut to size and place on ½ MS agar plates (MS 2.15 g L⁻¹, 1 % sucrose, 1 % gelrite, pH 5.8). Sow sterilized seeds from verified T2/T3 transgenic lines (Col‑0 or N. benthamiana) onto the mesh, orient plates vertically and grow seedlings in a growth chamber (22 °C day/19 °C night, 14 h light) until they are 5 days old (or up to 2 weeks for later experiments). Verify expression of TurboID constructs by western blot if desired.

steps.title: Biotin vacuum infiltration
steps.instruction: Prepare 50 µM biotin in infiltration buffer (0.5 M MES, 10 mM, 1 M MgCl₂, 10 mM; total 100 mL). Add 50–75 mL of this solution to each plate so seedlings are fully submerged. Apply vacuum at 0.09 MPa for 1 min, then release slowly. Perform the infiltration gently to avoid seedling damage.

steps.title: Biotin incubation
steps.instruction: Pour off excess biotin solution, return plates to the growth chamber and incubate seedlings for 24 h. (Biotin incubation time can be optimized; the authors tested 0.5–24 h and found 24 h gave the best biotinylation.)

steps.title: Heat stress treatment (optional)
steps.instruction: For heat‑stress experiments, transfer seedlings to a 37 °C incubator for 2 h before harvesting. For older Arabidopsis plants, infiltrate mature leaves with 50 µM biotin using a 1 mL syringe until the leaf is fully infiltrated.

steps.title: Formaldehyde crosslinking
steps.instruction: Collect ~2 g fresh seedlings into a 50 mL RNase‑free tube containing 36 mL RNase‑free ddH₂O. Add 1 mL 37 % (v/v) formaldehyde, mix well and apply vacuum at 0.09 MPa for 15 min (for difficult tissue use 1–1.5 h with two vacuum cycles). Perform this step in a chemical fume hood and wear appropriate PPE.

steps.title: Quench crosslinking with glycine
steps.instruction: Add 2.5 mL 2 M glycine (final 125 mM) to the tube, mix and apply vacuum for 5 min to stop the crosslinking reaction.

steps.title: Rinse seedlings
steps.instruction: Rinse the seedlings five times with 50 mL RNase‑free ddH₂O each time to remove residual formaldehyde.

steps.title: Harvest and flash‑freeze tissue
steps.instruction: Remove all liquid with tissue paper, immediately flash‑freeze the seedlings in liquid N₂ and store at –80 °C until further processing (pause point).

steps.title: Prepare required buffers
steps.instruction:
Prepare the following buffers just before use (all volumes are for a 10 mL stock unless noted):
• Extraction buffer (EB): 500 µL 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 7.5, 333.3 µL 5 M NaCl, 25 µL 1 M MgCl₂, 2 mL 50 % glycerol, 250 µL 20 % Triton X‑100, 100 µL 0.1 M PMSF, 100 µL protease‑inhibitor cocktail (1 %), 5 µL RNase inhibitor (20 U mL⁻¹). Adjust to 10 mL with nuclease‑free water.
• Wash buffer: 200 µL 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 7.5, 333.3 µL 5 M NaCl, 25 µL 1 M MgCl₂, 2 mL 50 % glycerol, 100 µL 20 % Triton X‑100, 5 µL 1 M DTT, 10 µL protease‑inhibitor cocktail (1 %), 5 µL RNase inhibitor (20 U mL⁻¹). Adjust to 10 mL.
• Dilution buffer: same as wash buffer but without Triton X‑100 and DTT (protease‑inhibitor cocktail 1 % and RNase inhibitor 20 U mL⁻¹ added). Adjust to 10 mL.
• Elution buffer: 1 mL 2× Laemmli buffer, 200 µL 50 mM biotin, 400 µL 10 % SDS, 200 µL 1 M DTT, 200 µL ddH₂O (total 2 mL). Prepare fresh.
• Protease K buffer: 30 µL 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 8.0 (final 30 mM) brought to 1 mL with water.
• Homogenization buffer: 1 mL 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 8.0 (100 mM), 200 µL 5 M NaCl (100 mM), 10 µL 0.5 M EDTA (0.5 mM), 25 µL 1 M MgCl₂ (2.5 mM), 100 µL 0.1 M PMSF (1 mM), 100 µL β‑mercaptoethanol (1 %). Adjust to 10 mL.
• 3 M NaAc: dissolve 24.6102 g NaAc in 100 mL water, adjust pH to 5.2 with 10 N NaOH.

steps.title: Extract proteins from tissue
steps.instruction: Grind frozen seedlings to a fine powder in liquid N₂. Add extraction buffer at a 1:2 (w/v) ratio (e.g., 5 mL powder + 5 mL buffer) in a 15 mL Falcon tube. Incubate on a shaker at 4 °C for 15–30 min, then centrifuge at 13 000 × g for 30 min at 4 °C. Transfer the clear supernatant to a new tube.

steps.title: Clarify extract and remove free biotin
steps.instruction: Pass the supernatant through a two‑layered Miracloth. Load the filtrate onto a PD‑10 column pre‑equilibrated with 25 mL extraction buffer (without protease inhibitor). Collect the flow‑through (≈3.5 mL) in a 15 mL Falcon tube and keep on ice.

steps.title: Equilibrate streptavidin beads
steps.instruction: Place Dynabeads™ MyOne Streptavidin C1 on a DynaMag™‑2 magnet, discard supernatant and wash the beads three times with 500 µL cold wash buffer.

steps.title: Capture biotinylated proteins
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL equilibrated beads to the biotin‑depleted flow‑through, rotate gently at 4 °C for 2 h (20–40 rpm) or overnight if bait expression is low.

steps.title: Wash streptavidin beads
steps.instruction: Using the magnet, wash the beads five times with 1 mL wash buffer, then twice with 1 mL dilution buffer (no Triton X‑100). Discard supernatant after each wash.

steps.title: Test capture efficiency (optional)
steps.instruction: Remove 5 % of the beads, elute proteins with 60 µL 2× Laemmli buffer containing 5 mM biotin, 2 % SDS and 100 mM DTT. Heat at 95 °C for 20 min and analyse by western blot.

steps.title: Proteinase K digestion for RNA release
steps.instruction: Resuspend the beads in 100 µL protease K buffer, add 2 µL RNase inhibitor (0.8 U µL⁻¹) and 4 µL Proteinase K (0.8 µg µL⁻¹). Mix gently and incubate at 55 °C for 30 min to release RNA and proteins.

steps.title: Add homogenization buffer
steps.instruction: Transfer the digestion mixture to a new 1.5 mL LoBind tube and add homogenization buffer to bring the total volume to 400 µL. Vortex briefly.

steps.title: Phenol‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL phenol‑chloroform‑isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1, pH 4–5) to the tube, mix vigorously, then centrifuge at >19 000 × g for 15 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Precipitate RNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the upper aqueous phase (300–400 µL) to a fresh tube, add an equal volume of isopropanol, 0.1 vol 3 M NaAc (pH 5.2), and 2 µL GlycoBlue. Mix and incubate at –20 °C for 1–2 h.

steps.title: Pellet RNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at >19 000 × g for 20 min at 4 °C. A tiny blue pellet (from GlycoBlue) should be visible at the tube bottom.

steps.title: Ethanol wash RNA pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet with 750 µL 75 % ethanol, invert twice, centrifuge at >19 000 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant and repeat the ethanol wash once more.

steps.title: Dry and resuspend RNA
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the pellet in a fume hood (do not over‑dry), then resuspend in 15 µL RNase‑, DNase‑ and protease‑free water. Store at –80 °C (pause point).

steps.title: DNase and rRNA depletion
steps.instruction: Treat ~2 µg of the purified RNA with DNase I and the RiboMinus™ Plant kit according to the manufacturers’ instructions. After cleanup, ~1 µg RNA is typically recovered. Quantify RNA using the Qubit® RNA HS Assay kit.

steps.title: Construct cDNA library
steps.instruction: Use the NEBNext Ultra™ II RNA Library Prep Kit with sample purification beads and NEBNext Multiplex Oligos for Illumina (Dual Index Primers Set 1). Follow the kit protocol: end‑repair, adaptor ligation, size selection, and PCR enrichment. Quantify the final library with Qubit® dsDNA HS assay and assess fragment size distribution on an Agilent BioAnalyzer. Prepare the library for Illumina sequencing.

steps.title: Reverse transcribe RNA
steps.instruction: For each sample, combine 500 ng RNA with either 0.5 µL 100 µM oligo(dT) or 1 µL 50 µM random hexamers, 1 µL 10 mM dNTP, and water to 13 µL. Heat at 65 °C for 5 min, then place on ice ≥1 min. Prepare RT mix: 4 µL 5× SSIV buffer, 1 µL 0.1 M DTT, 1 µL RNase inhibitor (40 U µL⁻¹), 0.5 µL SuperScript IV RT, 0.5 µL water. Add the RT mix to the RNA mix, incubate at 55 °C for 15 min, then inactivate at 80 °C for 10 min. Store cDNA at –80 °C or use immediately for qPCR.

steps.title: qRT‑PCR analysis
steps.instruction: Set up qRT‑PCR reactions with primers specific for RNAs of interest and appropriate controls. Run reactions on a real‑time PCR instrument and analyse data using the 2‑ΔΔCT method.

steps.title: Sequencing
steps.instruction: Submit the indexed cDNA libraries for paired‑end 2 × 150 bp Illumina sequencing (e.g., Novogene). Include total‑RNA samples (non‑crosslinked) as controls for enrichment calculations.

steps.title: Bioinformatic analysis
steps.instruction: Perform Gene Ontology enrichment using the Panther database or Bioconductor packages in R. Visualise interaction networks in Cytoscape 3.5.1 with an edge‑weighted spring‑embedded layout (NormSpec as edge weight). Manually adjust node positions, export the layout as PDF and convert to TIFF for figures.
